climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: An AVA covering much of the Indiana Uplands in south-central Indiana. It borders the Ohio River Valley AVA, whose boundary was cut back to avoid an overlap. It started with 19 vineyards on about 200 acres and 17 wineries.
